# FasPsych

> FasPsych is a leading telepsychiatry and integrated telehealth platform connecting organizations with licensed psychiatric providers for virtual mental health services across all age groups and clinical settings.

FasPsych specializes in telepsychiatry integration, staffing, and on-demand psychiatric services for hospitals, clinics, community mental health centers, and federally qualified health centers. The platform leverages PMHNPs, APRNs, and board-certified psychiatrists to deliver 24/7 virtual mental health evaluations, medication management, crisis intervention, and specialized care including MAT and geriatric psychiatry.

## Key Topics

- Telepsychiatry
- Telehealth Integration

## Clinical Service Lines

- [Adult Psychiatry Services & Virtual Mental Health Care](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/adult-psychiatric-services): Adult psychiatry services: evaluation, diagnosis, and medication management
- [Licensed Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Services](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/child-and-adolescent-psychiatric-services): Virtual child and adolescent psychiatric services for youth mental health
- [Geriatric Psychiatry Services | Telepsychiatry for Seniors](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/geriatric-psychiatry): Specialized mental health care for older adults and senior care orgs
- [Virtual Mental Health Evaluations & Assessments | 24/7 Care](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/mental-health-evaluation): Fast virtual behavioral health assessments from credentialed professionals
- [Online Medication Management Services | Prescriptions & Care](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/medication-management): Online medication management and prescriptions from psychiatric providers

## Specialized Care & Staffing Solutions

- [Emergency Room Mental Health Crisis Services | ER Crisis Care](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/emergency-room-mental-health-crisis-services): 24/7 ER crisis care and psychiatric evaluations with EMR integration
- [Virtual Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) | Substance Use Care](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/medication-assisted-treatment): Virtual MAT services for opioid and substance use disorders
- [On-Demand Psychiatry Services | 24/7 On-Call Psychiatrist](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/on-demand-psychiatry): 24/7 on-demand psychiatry services for clinics and facilities
- [Telepsychiatry Staffing Solutions for Clinics & Hospitals](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/telepsychiatry-staffing): Telepsychiatry staffing for clinics and hospitals with consultations
- [Virtual Rounding Services | Clinical and Mental Health Care](https://faspsych.com/telepsychiatry-services/virtual-rounding): Virtual rounding by psychiatrists and NPs in EDs and hospitals

## Integrated Care & Leadership
